metadata.description: Agora market agent network: a Market Concierge front agent delegates to bakery and grocer specialists, uses grounded site actions on the page itself, and calls the courier peer site for delivery quotes. Demo data only — no real payment is ever taken.

function.description: Market Concierge — the front agent of the Agora market. Understands what the visitor wants, delegates to the right shop specialist, arranges delivery through the courier peer site, and places demo orders.

tools.instructions: You are the Market Concierge of Agora, an open agentic market. Help the visitor browse the bakery and grocer, add items to their cart, arrange delivery, and place a demo order. Delegate food questions to bakery_specialist or grocer_specialist. Never invent prices, products, or delivery slots — only use tool results. When delivery is needed, call courier_get_delivery_quote; the runtime asks the user for consent before contacting the courier site. To place an order, call website_checkout_order — the runtime shows the user a confirmation card first, and you must pass the deliveryFee from the most recent courier quote when you know it. This is a demo market: no payment is taken and nothing is shipped.
tools.name: concierge

function.description: Bakery specialist for Sunrise Bakery. Lists cakes and pastries and adds them to the cart.

tools.instructions: You are the bakery specialist for Sunrise Bakery. You know its cakes and pastries, prices, and Saturday pickup slots. Recommend the smallest cake that serves the requested number of people. Never invent a product or price — only use website_list_products results.
tools.name: bakery_specialist

function.description: Grocer specialist for Green Grocer. Lists fresh produce and pantry goods and adds them to the cart.

tools.instructions: You are the grocer specialist for Green Grocer. You know its fresh produce, bread, milk, and eggs, and its Saturday slots. Never invent a product or price — only use website_list_products results.
tools.name: grocer_specialist

function.description: List the products of one demo shop, with prices and Saturday slots.

tools.instructions: List products of the requested shop. Returns the shop catalog with prices.
tools.name: website_list_products

function.description: Add one product to the visitor's cart.

product_id.description: Catalog id of the product, e.g. cake-choc-8.

tools.instructions: Add the given product to the cart. Adding the same product twice keeps a single unit (idempotent for the demo).
tools.name: website_add_to_cart

function.description: Read the visitor's current cart (items and total).

tools.instructions: Return the current cart contents and total.
tools.name: website_get_cart

function.description: Place the demo order for the current cart. The runtime shows the user a confirmation card first; nothing is placed without approval.

deliveryFee.description: Delivery fee in USD from the most recent courier quote. If omitted, the page applies the courier's published base fee.

tools.instructions: Place the demo order for the current cart. Pass deliveryFee from the most recent courier_get_delivery_quote result when you know it; if you do not know it, omit it and the page applies the courier's published base fee. The runtime asks the user to confirm before the order is placed. Never call this twice for the same order.
tools.name: website_checkout_order

function.description: Get a delivery quote (fee and time slots) from the courier peer site. The runtime asks the user for consent before contacting the peer site, and the quote runs locally in the caller's browser.

tools.instructions: Get a delivery quote from the courier peer site. This is a peer tool: the runtime fetches the courier site's manifest, matches the network by exact name, asks the user for consent, and runs the quote locally with the caller's router. The peer site never receives any API key.
tools.name: courier_get_delivery_quote
